theme_strategy.description: A high-contrast, technical dark-mode base with vibrant orange accents to convey precision, authority, and modern manufacturing capabilities.

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use extreme weights (Light or Black). Never center-align by default.

colors.rules: No full-screen generic gradients. Use texture or noise overlays. Dark slate is not pure black—it has a subtle blue/cool tint.

surfaces.name: Tracing Beam Cards
surfaces.description: A subtle animated gradient border around the edge, implemented via Framer Motion or CSS mask-image.

textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay across the hero section.
Tech-grid background (repeating linear gradients or TSParticles).

bento_grid.name: Mode A: Tetris Grid
bento_grid.rules: Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12. Gap: gap-8 to gap-12. Never fill 100% perfectly, leave negative space.

layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, labels. Center-align only intentionally for visual hierarchy.
layouts.general: Always mobile-first responsive. Generous spacing (py-24 or py-32 for sections).

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements (scale up, border color shift).
Staggered entrance animations for bento grid items.
MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion.
Smooth scroll using lenis (if possible, else CSS scroll-behavior).

examples.stagger_container: { hidden: { opacity: 0 }, show: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1 } } }
examples.fade_up_item: { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark overlays (bg-slate-950/80) or text-shadows.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative icons.

media.image_constraints: Max height 80vh on mobile. Lazy load all images below the fold.

image_urls.description: Detailed view of CNC grinding machine shaping ceramic material with precision tool.
Two metal mechanical parts on engineering blueprints
graphs of performance analytics on a laptop screen

3d_libraries.usage: Use a subtle animated CSS grid pattern or light particles in the hero background to avoid heavy performance hits. Keep it performant.

components_to_build.hero: Dark mode hero with an abstract tech grid, overlapping the CNC precision image. Massive Chivo typography. Orange primary CTA.
components_to_build.trusted_by: A marquee (using framer-motion or CSS animation) showing generic manufacturing company names paired with Lucide icons (e.g., Factory, Cpu, Zap).
components_to_build.how_it_works: Vertical timeline or staggered grid with steps 01-06. Clear, structural lines.
components_to_build.bento_features: Showcase AI Drawing Analysis, Smart Vendor Matching, etc., using the Bento Grid Protocol. Cards with subtle borders that light up on hover.
components_to_build.split_cta: Dual CTAs for Buyers (Upload Drawing) and Vendors (Join Network) in a high-contrast container.
components_to_build.contact: Integrate the existing contact form but restyle it with the new technical dark/slate theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: Transform LandingPage.jsx completely. Ditch the white background, go with Slate-950 dark mode base.
Apply the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype. Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do NOT use Inter.
Ensure the hero section is visually stunning with a layered CNC image, tech grid background, and high contrast typography.
Implement the Bento Grid Protocol for the capabilities section.
Preserve existing auth links, form submission logic, and ChatbotWidget.
Do NOT add universal transitions. Target specific properties.
Add data-testid attributes to EVERY button, link, and input.
Make the page feel like an elite, precision B2B manufacturing SaaS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...), Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Use a clear visual hierarchy driven by typography size, weight, and contrast.
Forms should have clear validation states and always communicate constraints inline.
Keep cognitive load low by grouping related information into discrete containers (cards, sections).
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA or at least WCAG AA standards.
